answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 51 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a fable bet on surviving 51 epochs of grading, and every pulse settlement recomputes the echo schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 20 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 15 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
